name: Antigravity CLI

version_poll.format: HTML (Astro/Starlight docs site), not markdown. `https://antigravity.google/changelog` now serves a client-side `<meta http-equiv="refresh">` stub pointing at `/docs/changelog` (not an HTTP 3xx — `curl -L` will not follow it), which is the real page: fetch that URL directly. The page carries four product tab panels, `<div class="rn-panel" id="panel-hub|ide|sdk|cli" role="tabpanel" data-panel-id="hub|ide|sdk|cli">`. The default (visible, `style="display: block;"`) panel is the Antigravity 2.0 hub, whose versions are 2.x; the CLI panel is `data-panel-id="cli"` and ships hidden (`style="display: none;"`), so read it from the raw HTML rather than from whatever renders first.
version_poll.filter:
inside `id="panel-cli"` only, each release is an `
`; its version link is `vX.Y.Z` and its date is `Month DD, YYYY` in the same `rn-version-col`. The newest row also carries `Latest`.
version_poll.transform: version = the `title="View release X.Y.Z"` value (identical to the link text minus the leading `v`); date = the `<time>` text parsed to YYYY-MM-DD
version_poll.reject: any version >= 2.0.0 — that is the hub, IDE or SDK panel, never the CLI

cross_check: HTTP only: the matched row's version link href must be exactly `/download#antigravity-cli`, its date must be on or after the placemat's `Content synced` date, and every version between the current `.release-tag` and the new one must also appear as an `id="rel-cli-X.Y.Z"` article inside `id="panel-cli"`. A run that cannot reach the page fails loudly; it never reports 'nothing newer'.
local_binary: Optional, only where a binary is installed (cloud runs have none and must not treat its absence as a no-op): `agy --version` for the installed version, `agy --help` as ground truth for `card-cli` flags and subcommands at that version
release_notes: Read every `cli` panel row between the current and newest version. Each row has an `<h3>` title, a summary paragraph, and `Improvements (N)` / `Fixes (N)` / `Patches (N)` details lists. Ignore the hub, IDE and SDK panels entirely; keep CLI/TUI and core runtime items.
gotchas: `antigravity.google/changelog` is now a meta-refresh redirect to `antigravity.google/docs/changelog` — poll the latter directly, since `curl -L` does not follow a `<meta http-equiv="refresh">`

The changelog page's default tab is the Antigravity 2.0 hub (2.x); those versions are NOT the CLI. The CLI lives in the hidden `id="panel-cli"` / `data-panel-id="cli"` tab panel, currently 1.2.x. A poll that reads the first version on the page will always see 2.x and either skip the CLI forever or file a bogus 2.x release
Skills and rules follow progressive disclosure (only metadata loaded until activated)
Global rules live in `~/.gemini/GEMINI.md`; workspace rules in `.agents/rules/*.md`
Plugin system supports importing packages from both Gemini and Claude ecosystems (`agy plugin import`)
